verdict.rationale: Docs and community evidence show Semgrep scanning across many languages (Python, JS/TS, Ruby, YAML, HTML, CSS) and separately covering open-source package ecosystems via Semgrep Supply Chain (docs-11,12,13,23,29,44,55), plus a generic-pattern fallback for unsupported languages (docs-39). However there's no explicit doc listing 'all major languages/ecosystems' coverage, and a hands-on report shows Semgrep's parser failing on valid TypeScript syntax (comm-3), plus performance complaints scanning large multi-language codebases (comm-2, comm-7) that temper the breadth claim. missing for 10: an explicit enumerated language/ecosystem coverage matrix, resolution of the TypeScript parser bug, and independent benchmarking across the full claimed language set.
